name: Scheme
summary: Minimalist, lexically scoped Lisp dialect with first-class continuations, proper tail calls and hygienic macros, defined by the Revised^n Reports (R5RS, R6RS, R7RS) and extended by SRFIs.

level_notes.1: Defined by community reports: R5RS (1998), R6RS (2007, large and library-based) and R7RS-small (2013, the current small language; R7RS-large in progress). IEEE 1178-1990 is withdrawn. SRFIs are the community proposal process. Lambda Papers (Steele & Sussman, 1975-80) are the defining papers.
level_notes.0: Many independent implementations; Chez Scheme (R6RS, also Racket CS back end) and Chibi-Scheme (R7RS reference-like small implementation) are linked here. Guile and CHICKEN have their own entries.
